name: rslack-frontend
description: TypeScript sources and tooling for rslack's web UI, browser e2e run and diagram rendering. Not needed to build or run the Rust binary: the compiled web/app.js is committed.

scripts.build:web: esbuild frontend/src/app.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --charset=utf8 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* Generated from frontend/src/*.ts by esbuild (npm run build:web). Do not edit by hand. */" --outfile=web/app.js
scripts.check:web: npm run build:web && git diff --exit-code -- web/app.js
